query: Build both flow_1_submit_dispatch and flow_4_precheck_gate. Here's an export from our tenant to use as the template.
notes: flow_1 has a powerapps trigger; flow_4 has a sharepoint_item trigger. splitOn belongs on exactly one of them. Tests conditional rules rather than blanket ones.
expected_behavior: Produces TWO packages — a legacy package holds one flow
flow_1 (powerapps trigger) does NOT get splitOn, and the skill says why: a Power Apps trigger does not return an array
Both packages carry connectionReferences, apisMap, connectionsMap and definition.metadata verbatim from the template
All five files present in each package
Runs validate_flow.py on each and reports clean before handing over
Flags any REPLACE- placeholder that still needs filling
Tells the user the connection prompt at import is expected behaviour for a legacy package, not a failure
fail_if: Adds splitOn to the Power Apps trigger
Omits splitOn from the SharePoint trigger
Authors connectionReferences instead of carrying them
Puts both flows in one package
Presents a package before running the validator
